high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a Google search results page on a mobile device. The search query entered is "creator of bitcoin." The top result is for "Satoshi Nakamoto," described as a developer. Below the name, there is a photo of an older man wearing glasses and a suit, holding what appears to be an ID card. The source of the image is credited to Channel 4. The text below the photo provides an overview stating that Satoshi Nakamoto is the name used by the presumed pseudonymous person or persons who developed Bitcoin, authored the Bitcoin white paper.
